about: For @mackygolfs only. 6 putts that get REALLY close: the lip-out ('get a double, get a double' → hand over mouth → 'oh it lipped… freaking lipped'); the long orange-checker putt from the far camera ('get in there', stops a few feet short, tap 'get in'); the light-blue long putt where the low camera at the cup shows it stop inches from the hole while you crouch in the back; 'should not speak while putt— oh' → it slides by → the leg kick and dropped putter → 'doesn't freaking matter'; the short orange-checker miss → frozen squat → 'that is a tough bog after two incredibly perfect shots'; ends on 'blue ball lagged right on up to the edge of the hole / not quite going in yet' → the lag → 'and that is why she's blue boys'. Every putt kept whole from stroke to stop, reactions and swearing kept, no shirt wipes, no added text, no music, even loudness (far-away lines lifted). Outfits alternate. Nothing reused from comps 1–4. 47.5 s (drop the 5th bit if you want it under 45: 40 s). Proposed slot: Mon Oct 19, 6:47pm MT (7:47 CT), your @mackygolfs evening slot — first day that's 3+ days clear of the same footage on B. All cut from your true Dropbox originals. Preview copy here; the real file is full quality.
